subject: Crescendo co-sell demo — staging window & marketplace preflight
messages:
From: CloudWave SI <eng-sales@cloudwave.io>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crescendo co-sell demo — staging window & marketplace preflight

Hey Tessa —

Thanks for lining this up. We're excited to get Crescendo through the marketplace preflight. Quick notes: our SI lead (Anika) is available the week of June 24th but the marketplace PM asked for a demo and technical runthrough before the 27th to meet the listing cutoff.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 6/25 10:00–11:00
- Wed 6/26 08:00–09:00 (early slot for APAC overlap)

We have a short runbook draft — attaching. Can Redwood provide a facilitator and a short checklist for marketplace requirements? If possible, we'd like a 30-min rehearsal the day before.

Thanks,
Raj (CloudWave)

Attachment: crescendo_runbook_v1.pdf

From: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: CloudWave SI <eng-sales@cloudwave.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crescendo co-sell demo — staging window & marketplace preflight

Raj — appreciate the doc and clear windows. We can own facilitation and do the 30-min rehearsal. Quick constraints from our side:
- Vanessa (host) is free Tue 6/25 10:00 PT and can lead the public demo.
- Vivek (tech ops) can join Wed 6/26 08:00 but prefers 6/25 for lower cross-region risk.

My ask: can CloudWave confirm Anika's role for the rehearsal and who will present the marketplace checklist (AWS PM vs CloudWave)? Also tagging Karthik to confirm whether the Dedicated capacity demo segment requires a separate validation slot.

Proposed schedule:
- Tue 6/25 09:15–09:45 PT: internal rehearsal (Redwood + CloudWave)
- Tue 6/25 10:00–10:45 PT: joint demo (public)
- Wed 6/26 08:00–08:30 PT: fallback technical deep-dive (if needed)

Can you confirm? If yes, I will send calendar invites and include the marketplace checklist as an action item for the AWS PM.

Best,
Tessa

Signature: Tessa Morgan | Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

From: AWS Marketplace PM <pm-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, CloudWave SI <eng-sales@cloudwave.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crescendo co-sell demo — staging window & marketplace preflight

Hi all —

We can block Tue 6/25 10:00 PT for the marketplace-facing demo. For the checklist: I can cover listing requirements live, but need the artifact list by EOD 6/21 (logos, billing contact, SOC2 pointer). If you want a very short rehearsal with Marketplace watchers, 30 mins on 6/24 09:00 PT works.

One caveat: marketplace listing validation may take 2–3 business days post-demo if there are changes; please ensure the runbook highlights any custom network requirements.

— Priya (AWS Marketplace)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: CloudWave SI <eng-sales@cloudwave.io>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace PM <pm-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crescendo co-sell demo — staging window & marketplace preflight

All — locking Tue 6/25 09:15 rehearsal and 10:00 demo. I will host the demo and handle intros. Vivek — can you bring the Dedicated capacity slide and be ready for a 5–7 minute Q&A on latency targets? Karthik — if we need an external validation slot for the Dedicated piece, flag now and I'll carve out Wed 6/26 08:00.

CloudWave — please send final runbook by EOD 6/21 and the asset list to Priya. I'll send invites in the next 30 minutes.

V

From: CloudWave SI <eng-sales@cloudwave.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace PM <pm-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crescendo co-sell demo — staging window & marketplace preflight

Thanks — confirmed. Anika will present the SI integration and is on for the 9:15 rehearsal. We'll upload the asset bundle and the updated runbook (minor edits) to the Drive link you shared by EOD 6/21.

One quick note: Sienna Integrations will join the demo for the first 10 minutes to show the connector flow; they requested a short pre-demo handshake at 9:00 PT to validate IAM tokens. Is that OK with Redwood?

If yes, we'll add the 9:00–9:10 PT handshake to the rehearsal invite. Looking forward to the runthrough.

— Raj (CloudWave)
